name: ListVpcEndpointConnections

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the endpoint connections to query.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的终端节点连接的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to include a token for the next query. Valid values:
Leave this parameter empty for the first query or if no next query exists.
If a next query exists, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 1000. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小。取值范围：1~1000。默认值：50
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The endpoint elastic network interface (ENI) ID
parameters.name: eni_id

parameters.help_en:
The endpoint connection status. Valid values:

Pending: being modified.

Connecting: connecting.

Connected: connected.

Disconnecting: disconnecting.

Disconnected: disconnected.

Deleting: being deleted.

ServiceDeleted: the corresponding endpoint service has been deleted
parameters.help_zh:
终端节点连接状态，取值：

Pending：修改中。

Connecting：连接中。

Connected：已连接。

Disconnecting：断开连接中。

Disconnected：未连接。

Deleting：删除中。

ServiceDeleted：对应的终端节点服务已删除
parameters.name: connection_status

parameters.help_en: The ID of the account to which the endpoint belongs
parameters.name: endpoint_owner_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the service resource that is replaced in a smooth migration of EPS resource scenario
parameters.help_zh: 平滑迁移场景下被替换的服务资源ID
parameters.name: replaced_resource_id

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID of the endpoint to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的终端节点所属的资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

Bandwidth.description_en: The bandwidth of the endpoint connection. Unit: Mbit/s
Bandwidth.description_zh: 终端节点连接的连接带宽，单位：Mbps

ConnectionStatus.description_en:
The endpoint connection status. Valid values:

Pending: being modified.

Connecting: connecting.

Connected: connected.

Disconnecting: disconnecting.

Disconnected: disconnected.

Deleting: being deleted.

ServiceDeleted: the corresponding endpoint service has been deleted
ConnectionStatus.description_zh:
终端节点连接状态，取值：

Pending：修改中。

Connecting：连接中。

Connected：已连接。

Disconnecting：断开连接中。

Disconnected：未连接。

Deleting：删除中。

ServiceDeleted：对应的终端节点服务已删除

EndpointOwnerId.description_en: The ID of the account to which the endpoint belongs

EndpointRegionId.description_en: The region ID of the endpoint
EndpointRegionId.description_zh: 终端节点所属的地域 ID

EndpointVpcId.description_en: The VPC to which the endpoint belongs
EndpointVpcId.description_zh: 终端节点所属的专有网络

ModifiedTime.description_en: The time when the connection was modified

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The resource group ID of the endpoint
ResourceGroupId.description_zh: 终端节点所属的资源组ID

ResourceOwner.description_en:
Indicates whether the endpoint and the endpoint service belong to the same account. Valid values:

true: yes.

false: no
ResourceOwner.description_zh:
终端节点和终端节点服务是否同一账号，取值：

true：是。

false：否

ServiceId.description_en: The ID of the endpoint service

ServiceRegionId.description_en: The region ID of the endpoint service
ServiceRegionId.description_zh: 终端节点服务所属的地域 ID

TrafficControlMode.description_en:
The traffic control mode. Valid values:

Scalability: automatic elastic scaling. In this mode, the connection bandwidth configured for the endpoint connection does not take effect.

BandwidthLimit: the bandwidth upper limit of the endpoint connection. The bandwidth upper limit is the Bandwidth value
TrafficControlMode.description_zh:
Scalability：自动弹性，在该模式下，针对终端连接设置的连接带宽无效。

BandwidthLimit：终端连接的带宽上限，带宽上限为Bandwidth值

EniId.description_en: The endpoint elastic network interface (ENI) ID

ReplacedEniId.description_en: The ID of the endpoint network interface controller (NIC) that is replaced in a smooth migration of EPS resource scenario
ReplacedEniId.description_zh: 平滑迁移场景下被替换的终端节点网卡ID

ReplacedResourceId.description_en: The ID of the service resource that is replaced in a smooth migration of EPS resource scenario
ReplacedResourceId.description_zh: 平滑迁移场景下被替换的服务资源ID

VSwitchId.description_en: The vSwitch to which the endpoint belongs
VSwitchId.description_zh: 终端节点所属的交换机

ZoneStatus.description_en:
The status of the zone. Valid values:
Creating: being created.
Wait: waiting for connection.
Connected: connected.
Deleting: being deleted.
Disconnecting: disconnecting.
Disconnected: disconnected.
Connecting: connecting.
Migrating: being migrated.
Migrated: migrated
ZoneStatus.description_zh:
可用区的状态。取值：
Creating：创建中。
Wait：等待连接。
Connected：已连接。
Deleting：删除中。
Disconnecting：断开连接中。
Disconnected：已断开。
Connecting：连接中。
Migrating：迁移中。
Migrated：已迁移

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries per page

NextToken.description_en:
Indicates whether a token for the next query exists. Valid values:
If NextToken is empty, no next query exists.
If NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries in the endpoint connection list
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的终端节点连接列表条目数
